title: You Just Got Laid Off. Now What?
problem: The reader has just lost a job unexpectedly and needs to understand what the experience is doing emotionally and practically before making sensible next decisions.
target_reader: English-speaking professional recently laid off, usually reading within the first few days after the event.
promise: Help the reader understand the shock, separate job loss from personal worth, regain practical stability and move into a deliberate next phase.
market_evidence: Readers repeatedly seek immediate guidance after unexpected layoffs.
Existing market includes both long career books and workbook/checklist products; this product should occupy the short narrative guide position.
constraints: Write narrative non-fiction, not a workbook.
Do not invent a layoff story for the author.
Do not use stacked one-line paragraphs or social-media cadence.
Keep practical checklist material out of the main chapters.
Jurisdiction-specific employment claims require explicit qualification and reliable sourcing.
